name: Caesar
title: Dictator of Rome
description: Master of the legions and the art of swift conquest, Caesar bends every campaign to his will.

name: Cleopatra
title: Pharaoh of the Nile
description: The last active pharaoh, whose cunning kept Egypt standing against the greatest powers of her age.

name: Ragnar
title: The Fabled Raider
description: Legendary Norse raider whose longships struck fear across every coastline he touched.

name: Sun Tzu
title: The Art of War
description: The strategist who taught that supreme excellence lies in winning without fighting.

name: Alexander
title: The Great Conqueror
description: Undefeated in battle, he carved an empire from Greece to the edge of the known world.

name: Genghis Khan
title: The Great Khan
description: Uniter of the steppes whose horde built the largest contiguous empire in history.

name: Richard the Lionheart
title: The Lion of England
description: A warrior-king whose courage on the battlefield became the stuff of legend.

name: Vercingetorix
title: The Gallic Warlord
description: The chieftain who united the Gauls and defied Rome at the gates of Alesia.

name: Boudica
title: The Avenger Queen
description: The warrior queen of the Iceni who burned three Roman cities in a blaze of vengeance.

name: Lady Six Sky
title: The Mayan Regent
description: Mayan regent who restored her dynasty and ruled with the gods at her back.

name: Leonidas
title: King of the 300
description: The Spartan king who held the Hot Gates against an empire with three hundred spears.

name: Napoleon
title: The Little Corporal
description: The artilleryman who crowned himself emperor and redrew the map of Europe.
